Yu 2016 proves a broad prior result on gamma-CDF single crossing; generic count-level single crossing and monotone gamma hazards are acknowledged as prior mathematics. No inspected primary statement was found that implies the complete joint theorem, but priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: The claim is a complete shape-sharp all-real-parameter classification for a natural normalized surveillance observation after abruptly halted incidence growth. Matched mean delays can give opposed count and local-growth rankings, and those rankings switch at two rigorously ordered horizons. That precise result informs interpretation of simulated nowcasting/surveillance comparison and is not merely a one-point numerical example; applicability to real outbreaks is expressly excluded.
